head: Who’s in net for the Oilers?
paras: The Rangers are on a three-game losing streak. The Oilers are 9-2-2.
At home, Mike Sullivan likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Oilers’ fourth line. The Oil played last night; the Rangers are rested.

items.text: The Oilers are newly without Zach Hyman, and have had to make do without Matt Savoie all season.
Sean Durzi has a point in six straight games against Edmonton.
Connor McDavid has a point in every game this season.
The Oilers’ record (.769) is well ahead of what their chances are worth (.622), largely thanks to their shooting.

NYR.head: Too close to call
NYR.body: Edmonton has been out-chancing opponents lately, but the Rangers have home-ice advantage, and the Oilers will be without Hyman. The Rangers can tip it if their power play gets going.

EDM.head: Nothing to separate these two
EDM.body: Edmonton has been out-chancing opponents lately, but the Rangers have home-ice advantage, and the Oilers will be without Hyman. The Oilers can tip it if their power play gets going.

calls.head: A tough night ahead for Michaels
calls.body: At home, the Rangers keep sending Schneider and Šmits out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Mike Sullivan has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ fourth lines. Tonight the Oilers’ fourth line is Frederic, Michaels and Howard.

calls.head: The schedule did the Oilers no favors
calls.body: The Oilers played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Rangers to control more of the play than they usually do.

calls.head: The Oilers can’t afford to take penalties
calls.body: The Oilers’ penalty kill is near the bottom of the league, and the Rangers’ power play is near the top. Discipline matters more than usual for the Oilers tonight.

calls.head: Expect a grind
calls.body: The Oilers play some of the league’s slowest games, and so do the Rangers. We think this one is even quieter than either team’s usual.
